Photos.Caption: No dear but it was still a great steak!
Finally...a sear (after I took it off bypass mode)!

Results.ReviewText: I am new to grilling and using a Weber. For my first several attempts, nothing seared. Nothing at all. It was frustrating! I could get a better sear or on the stove then on my Weber. After trying multiple attempts, I finally did some research and figured out the problem. My propane gas tank was on bypass mode. After closing the gas gauge, waiting a minute or so and then opening the gas and lighting my Weber Grill, my steaks finally seared! I have no idea why my grill was in this mode, but if you are having trouble with your heat, check the propane tank! If your grill is not smoking like crazy while you are cooking at the highest heat with the lid down, than you are likely in bypass mode. It’s not you, the meat or the grill grates. At full capacity, the heat gets so high that my infrared thermometer can’t even detect the heat. That’s when you know you are using the heat to its capacity and not in bypass mode.
Results.Title: My steaks wouldn’t sear until I did this...
